doc.title: Charles Tolliver interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 6, 2021 [interview 1 of 2]

title: Expatriates in Copenhagen and Europe
summary: Sulieman, Sahib Shihab and Ben Webster found appreciation and respect in Copenhagen, as Bechet did in France.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: I think that Idrees and Sahib Shihab, they finally came back home before they passed away, but Ben Webster, he passed away in Copenhagen.
Do you think they found what they were looking for over there?

Oh absolutely. They had a chance to play more in the well known Montmarte in the case of Copenhagen you know, and just appreciated. You know they were loved by the localities where they lived you know, treated as high artists.
Yeah, like Sidney Bechet was sort of the king of that, I think, going to France.
Yeah. Well it was another time. The whole world was different then you know.
